thread: maddie: Quick sync: updated drilldown mock linked in the thread. Need decisions on: per-row export vs kebab menu, copy/correlation affordance, and stacktrace list accessibility. Figma: https://figma.redwood/app/drilldown-v4 eli: My take: Bulk export belongs in page toolbar. Per-row export is rare and noisy. Keep per-row: Copy ID, Open permalink, More (kebab) -> Export. tim: Agree re: bulk in toolbar. If someone wants a per-row export we can surface "Export row" in the kebab. For copy action make it a visible small button next to the ID. Important: 44px touch target and clear hover/active states. jyoti: Accessibility checklist: icon buttons must have aria-labels, focusable in logical order, visible focus indicator (2px high-contrast), and screen reader announcements for copy confirmation. Contrast for pill backgrounds must be >= 4.5:1. maddie: Microcopy suggestions: "Copy correlation id" preferred. Also debating visual truncation: show first 8 chars + ellipsis in list, full on drilldown. Copy should always send full id to clipboard. eli: Data point: support often pastes full id; truncation causes mistakes. If we truncate visually, add title attr and on focus show a tooltip with full ID. Also add a permalink icon to the left of the copy button for power users. tim: Implementation notes: sample markup we can reuse: ``` abcdef12... ``` and ARIA: use an aria-live region for the copied message: create element role=\"status\" aria-live=\"polite\" hidden until used. jyoti: Important: screen reader users should receive the full id even if visual truncation used. So aria-label must contain the full id. Also support keyboard activation via Enter/Space on the copy button. For copy failure (clipboard blocked) announce error: \"Copy failed, press Ctrl+C to copy\". sara: UX: For the copied feedback pattern, prefer a small tooltip saying "Copied" that times out after 1.5s. For errors show inline toast once. Analytics: fire event `correlation_copy` with hashed id and debounce repeated clicks for same row (5s). eli: Also consider an edge case: mobile long-press selection vs our copy button. On mobile, tapping the id should open drilldown; long-press should trigger native select. Keep copy button separate and visually prominent. maddie: Question: export formats? CSV for quick analysis, JSONL for logs. Kebab -> Export -> CSV / JSONL. Toolbar quick-export should default to CSV and offer JSONL in dropdown. tim: Dev note: exporting stacktrace rows should include trace id, correlation id, timestamp, service, and top frame. Also add a schema version header so older CSV parsers don't break. jyoti: A11y nit: Ensure export filename is descriptive (errors-YYYYMMDD.csv) and the generated link uses rel=\"noopener noreferrer\" when opening in new tab. Also keyboard users need to be able to trigger download via Enter. maddie: Decision recap: 1) Bulk export in top toolbar (CSV default, JSONL option). 2) Per-row kebab with "Export row" inside. 3) Copy correlation id as visible icon button with aria-label and aria-live feedback. 4) Truncate visually in list, full id via aria-label, tooltip, and drilldown. 5) Ensure focus order, contrast, and 44px touch targets. I'll update figma and add a PR for the component and accessibility tests. ux-bot: Reminder: add keyboard walkthrough and contrast report to the design-review checklist due Friday. :spiral_calendar:
